title: Interactive tutorial
subtitle: Learn NarraFork hands-on. Every lesson runs the real product — real narrators, real tools, real approvals. The model follows a script, so no AI API is called and nothing is billed.

trackDescriptions.conversation: A full conversation turn: reasoning, tool calls, approvals, interrupting, plan mode.
trackDescriptions.chapters: Projects are repositories, chapters are worktrees. Forking, the graph, merging back.
trackDescriptions.subagents: Delegating to explore/plan/general/review agents and running work in the background.

resetConfirmBody: Your recorded step progress for this lesson is cleared. The narrator session is kept. Starting again replays the script from the beginning of this lesson in the same conversation.
sandboxBody: Lessons that need a repository create a real git repository. It appears in your NarraFlow list and is unrelated to your own projects.
sandboxMissing: Not created yet. It appears when you start a lesson that needs it.
sandboxDeleteHint: To remove it, delete the narraflow like any other. It will be recreated the next time you start a lesson.
gitRequired: This lesson needs git, which is not available on this machine.
